text:
The sympathetic innervation to the colon and distal GI tract originates from the thoracolumbar spinal cord, specifically T10–L2 segments (preganglionic sympathetic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column). I disagree with the shared note: sympathetic supply to the lower gut is thoracolumbar, not lumbosacral — lumbosacral (S2–S4) outflow is parasympathetic, not sympathetic.
CONFIDENCE: 93
